ev.q: The writing is as strong and relevant now as ever
their unique brand of humor to video gaming.
the story and the crude moments are so much better on this game
I ended up fighting Nazi-zombie cows, getting beaten up by underpants gnomes
towards the very end of the game you can just rinse and repeat the same style of moves
because you get so powerful so fast
The humor, characters, art style, and ridiculous situations all capture the show perfectly
All the characters and situations are exactly what South Park is all about.
The sole reason humans and elves are locked in a neverending war
The Difficulty: Harder than Dark Souls.
